insuficiente.headline: Foundations to consolidate
insuficiente.recommendation: Revisit the fundamentals of the case and rebuild the analysis from verified evidence before moving on.

suficiente.headline: In progress
suficiente.recommendation: There is a correct base; reinforce justification and the traceability of claims to move up a band.

notable.headline: Solid
notable.recommendation: Solid analysis; polish the weakest criteria and make limits and alternatives explicit to reach excellence.

excelente.headline: Excellent
excelente.recommendation: Excellent level; keep the rigour and use this work as a reference to review cases with pending data.

levels.insuficiente: Prioritise this criterion: start from a case-bank example and rebuild it with verified evidence.
levels.suficiente: Meets the basics: add explicit justification and cite the sources supporting each claim.
levels.notable: Good level: contrast with alternatives and flag pending fields to close the gap towards excellent.
levels.excelente: Top level: document the criterion and its limits so it serves as a reference for other reviews.
